planner.text: Let me look at the layout and the failing tests.

input.summary: Two independent bugs: apply_discount returns the discount amount instead of the discounted price, and slugify neither collapses repeated separators nor strips them from the ends.

subtasks.title: Fix apply_discount
subtasks.description: In shop/pricing.py, apply_discount(price, percent) returns price * percent / 100 (the discount itself). It must return the discounted price, price * (1 - percent / 100), rounded to cents. cart_total relies on it. Tests: tests/test_pricing.py.

subtasks.title: Fix slugify
subtasks.description: In shop/text.py, slugify must collapse runs of non-alphanumeric characters into a single '-' and strip leading/trailing '-'. Tests: tests/test_text.py.

worker-1.text: apply_discount returns the discount, not the discounted price. Fixing at the root so cart_total is fixed too.

input.summary: apply_discount now returns price * (1 - percent/100); all pricing tests pass (cart_total fixed through it). Remaining slugify failures belong to the other subtask.
slugify collapses separator runs with [^a-z0-9]+ and strips edge dashes; text tests pass.

input.feedback: Root-cause fix, minimal diff, subtask tests pass.
